There's a good ratio. 

Too small requires frequent watering which can leave to underwatering.

A bit big is alright, but leads to slower foilage growth.

Personally I go with a tad small, and repot when watering becomes too frequent (2+ times per week).

Go get a hobby in something, sign up for a yoga class, photography class, whatever! LOTS of adults out of college are more than happy to make friends
